p: At Dot, we're not just revolutionizing finance; we're cultivating a vibrant community that fuels innovation and change. Join us on this exciting journey through three unique avenues: our Campus Ambassador Program, Dot Internship, and Dot Fellowship.

Welcome to Dot, where finance meets community, and your financial journey becomes an adventure. We've created a space that's not just about money; it's about you, your dreams, and your path to success. Here’s how it works:
Become a catalyst for change on your college campus. As a Dot Campus Ambassador, you'll spearhead efforts to grow our user base and spread financial literacy.
Dot fellows are picked from the campus ambassador team after 3 months, and all fellows must go through the campus ambassador program.
Our Dot Internship is your gateway. Immerse yourself in a dynamic environment where you'll gain hands-on experience, work on groundbreaking projects, and learn from industry experts.
